title: Device identity (device_identity.json)
description: The identity a device keeps in its data directory, device_identity.json, schema_version 1. A serial reads PB<number>-<maker>-<hardware id>; the maker code comes from the maker registry (popboll.makers/1). Only "serial" is needed to read the file; a writer writes every member except provisioned_at, which is added when the device is given its number.

number.description: The unit's number; 0 until it is provisioned.

maker.description: The serial's maker code; empty when the serial does not parse.

serial.description: Any serial in the field, virtual ones (VPB...) and old test serials included.

device_serial.description: A physical device's serial, strictly. Its maker code must also be registered as first-party or third-party, which a schema cannot check.

maker_code.description: 3 to 6 upper-case letters or digits, starting with a letter.
